body:
Reworks the desktop window shell to fix long-standing input/feel papercuts, and removes the mini-player/PiP mode in favor of a plain stay-on-top toggle. Also carries the branch's "Remember episode track selections" feature.

## What changed
- **DPI-correct titlebar hit-testing.** Titlebar height (32), window-button width (138) and resize border (6) are defined once in logical px and DPI-scaled, so the draggable caption and button zones line up with the rendered overlay at every scale. Hit-testing is now a pure `nc_hit()` with unit tests at 96/120/144/192 DPI — replaces the flat `32`/`140` that dead-zoned drag above 100%.
- **Mini-player/PiP deleted → stay-on-top.** Removed end to end (`window_pip`, `mini_pointer_inside`, `/pip`, the native-frame swap, PiP rect math, the mini-controls↔PiP coupling) and replaced with a pure topmost Z-order toggle (`window_on_top`, `/stay-on-top`, `i` / pin button) that keeps existing chrome and the single control bar. Compact controls now follow window *width*, not a mode.
- **Single-owner control visibility.** Collapsed the 7-flag hover tangle (native pointer-inside, cap timer, parked-hit-test, document-leave effect) into one idle timer + state with explicit keep-open inputs.
- **Dedup.** Triplicated relayout folded into one `relayout()` helper.
- **Docs.** New `docs/feature-contracts/desktop-shell.md`; `desktop-status.md` updated to `window_on_top`.

## Migration policy
Old path removed, not flagged. A test fails if `window_pip`/`mini_pointer_inside` reappear; the install smoke script drives `/stay-on-top`.

## Deferred (named scope, not optional)
Idle-GPU present-on-frame was attempted and **reverted** — it regressed first paint to a blank window in WebView2 visual-hosting (overlay appearance is coupled to the per-tick present). Documented as deferred in the shell contract; needs live verification before it can ship.

## Verification
- `cargo test -p shows-desktop` → 17 passed (incl. new DPI hit-test cases)
- `tsc --noEmit` clean
- Release built, installed, and confirmed by hand: UI renders, hover correct, `i`/stay-on-top works.
